messages.author: 453ddfeccaf29bbb
messages.subject: ADVI in RStan/PyStan + website
parts:
hi ben, allen, et. al.,

@et.al: awesome work in getting 2.9.0 out!

i'd like to edit the nips page with instructions for ADVI, and i want to make sure i'm on the right page.

@ben: the develop branch of RStan is up to date with 2.9, right? so people follow the instructions here, it should (pretty much) work?

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

@allen: is PyStan up to date too? if not, is there anything i can help with on that?

many thanks in advance!

cheers
alp

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: ADVI in RStan/PyStan + website
parts:
On Sunday, December 6, 2015 at 4:30:14 PM UTC-5, Alp Kucukelbir wrote:
@ben: the develop branch of RStan is up to date with 2.9, right? so people follow the instructions here, it should (pretty much) work?

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

They must start with that in order to have the appropriate toolchain / configuration and to get rstan 2.8.2 with its dependencies but that doesn't have ADVI. Then do

if(!require(devtools)) install.packages("devtools")
# get 2.8.9 versions, which are essentially 2.9.0
devtools::install_git("git://github.com/stan-dev/rstan", subdir = "StanHeaders")
devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstan", subdir = "rstan/rstan", branch = "develop")
devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstanarm", local = FALSE)

But I still need to push some things this evening.

Ben
